name: BeyondSight
tagline: A haptic vest and Braille gauntlet that guide DeafBlind people to objects and help them communicate.

awards: Genesys: Empathy in Action with Genesys Cloud APIs

problem: DeafBlind people have few tools for independent navigation and conversation.
solution: A depth camera and four vest motors give direction cues; a Braille keypad on the gauntlet requests objects or destinations; haptic modes convey instructions and nearby presence; voice services bridge communication.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask for a chair on the keypad and follow the vibrations to it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Genesys: Empathy in Action with Genesys Cloud APIs” among 261 submissions.
A full wearable system, not a single feature.

lessons: Designing for the hardest-to-serve user makes the engineering visible and meaningful.
